domains.name: Language Knowledge — Grammar + Reading (文法・読解)

exam_rules: Multiple-choice OMR (bubble sheet) answer format. No speaking or free-writing sections. No electronic devices permitted. Pencil (HB or B) and eraser required. Candidates must arrive at least 30 minutes before the exam start time. Late entry not permitted after the exam begins.
id_requirements: Valid government-issued photo ID required. In Japan: My Number Card, driver's license, passport, or health insurance card with photo. Overseas: Passport or equivalent national ID.

lifecycle.summary: Confirmed current on the issuer host on 2026-09-19: "The JLPT has five levels: N1, N2, N3, N4 and N5."

official_study_resources.title: JLPT Official Practice Workbooks (日本語能力試験公式問題集)
JLPT Can-do Statements and Level Summary

prerequisites.description: N3-level Japanese or equivalent (~1,000 kanji, ~6,000 words)

retake_policy.notes: JLPT is held twice per year (July and December). Candidates may register for both sessions in the same year. No minimum waiting period between attempts.

testing_centers.provider: JLPT Official Exam Sites (Japan Foundation / JEES)
